normalization.body_rows: sorted by numeric row ID and concatenated within each article; line breaks are removed
normalization.phonetic_annotations: all brace annotations such as {shang5} removed
normalization.layout_symbols: 〓, ●, ○, △, ▲ explicitly removed and counted; Unicode control/format/surrogate/unassigned characters are also removed
normalization.unicode: NFKC; compatibility target forms are mapped before punctuation filtering
normalization.standalone_targets: ，。？！；：、 plus ASCII compatibility forms and standalone ∶ (colon) become the label on the immediately preceding character
normalization.consecutive_targets: the final target mark overwrites earlier marks on that preceding character
normalization.unsupported_punctuation: removed from the input character skeleton and counted by character
normalization.internal_punctuation: removed, except a period between digits inside the same token; such decimal points remain input characters with NONE labels
normalization.deduplication: SHA-256 of normalized character skeleton plus label-byte sequence; first sorted article ID retained
